services.name: Uncontested probate
services.basis: For an estate with assets in the UK where nobody disputes the will. The price depends on how many assets there are, whether there is a property to sell and whether inheritance tax is payable.
includes: Gathering in and valuing the assets
Applying for the grant of probate
Paying debts and distributing the estate
excludes: Disputes over the will or the estate
Selling a property (we quote for this separately)
Estates with assets outside the UK

disbursements.name: Probate application fee
disbursements.note: Set by HM Courts & Tribunals Service; we tell you the current fee when we start.

disbursements.name: Notices in The Gazette and a local newspaper
disbursements.note: Protect the executors against unknown debts; we quote before placing them.

disbursements.name: Bankruptcy search for each beneficiary
disbursements.note: A small fee per search; we tell you the amount when we start.

stages: Gathering in and valuing the assets
Distributing the estate and final accounts
services.timescale: Usually six to twelve months for an estate like this. Selling a property or a tax return can add time.
services.experience: Ann Hollin, partner, does and supervises the work.

complaints.intro: We want to hear when something has gone wrong, and to put it right.

steps.title: Tell us
steps.text: Write to our senior partner by email or letter, saying what went wrong and what you would like us to do.

steps.title: We acknowledge
steps.text: We confirm we have your complaint within three working days and tell you who is looking into it.

steps.title: We look into it
steps.text: Someone not involved in your matter reviews the file and may ask to talk to you.

steps.title: We reply in writing
steps.text: You receive our final response, with our reasons and what we will do, within eight weeks.
